name: Your First Days
description: Read this before your first night: drinking, clean water, food and staying warm.

pages.title: Your First Days
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Lake, sea and swamp water is **Dirty**: boil bottles in a furnace before you drink.
- Rain is free water: look straight up.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Snowy spawn? About 5 minutes, then the cold hurts. Get near a fire.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Melon slices count as a drink.
Read this before your first night. Three things can kill a new player here that can't in vanilla: **thirst**, **cold or heat**, and **dirty water**. All three are easy once you know the trick.

pages.title: How to drink
pages.text:
**Rain:** stand in the rain and look straight up. You drink a little every half second, for free.\
\
**By hand:** with both hands empty, crouch and right-click water. A quick sip, but raw water usually makes you sick.

pages.title: Dirty water
pages.text:
Lake, sea and swamp water is [#](7A3C9A)[Dirty](entry://glossary/purified_water)[#]().\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** drinking it always gives hunger and nausea, and 3 times in 10 poison too. You still get the water.\
\
Flowing water, and water above [#](7A3C9A)[Y](entry://glossary/y_level)[#]() 100 or below Y 48, is one step cleaner.

pages.title: Your first bottles
pages.text: Smelt sand into glass and craft 3 glass into 3 bottles. Right-click water to fill one, then hold right-click to drink it. Water bottles stack to 64.

pages.title: Boil it
pages.text:
Cook a filled bottle before you drink it.

- **Furnace:** Dirty turns straight into Acceptable, which is safe to live on.
- **Campfire:** one step cleaner per cook. Slow, but it needs no fuel.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** boil a stack while you work.

pages.title: Food that hydrates
pages.text:
Some food counts as a drink. [Melon slices](item://minecraft:melon_slice) are the best early pick, then apples, beetroot soup, carrots and berries.\
\
At 3 droplets or less you can't sprint, and at zero you start taking damage.

pages.title: Food
pages.text:
Hunger works like vanilla. Kill animals and cook the meat on a campfire or in a furnace, or fish. AppleSkin shows what each food restores.\
\
What to eat where: [#](2E5AAC)[Food in Your First Days](entry://food/first_food)[#]().\
\
Crops only grow in their season: [#](2E5AAC)[Seasonal Crops](entry://survival/seasons_crops)[#]() says which grows when.

pages.title: Cold and heat
pages.text:
Your [#](2E5AAC)[body temperature](entry://survival/temperature)[#]() is on the HUD. If you spawn in snow you get about 5 minutes of [#](7A3C9A)[grace](entry://glossary/grace)[#](), then the cold starts to hurt.\
\
Stand near a campfire, a lit furnace or lava to warm up. Getting wet chills you, which helps in a desert.

pages.title: Dress for it
pages.text:
Leather armor and furs [#](2E5AAC)[insulate](entry://survival/temperature_gear)[#](). A [Sewing Table](item://cold_sweat:sewing_table) (wool and planks) sews insulation like [Goat Fur](item://cold_sweat:goat_fur) onto any armor. Later a **Hearth** keeps a whole base comfortable.\
\
You can't sleep while freezing or overheating.

pages.title: Day one checklist
pages.text:
- Glass bottles, filled and boiled
- A campfire for light, warmth and clean water
- Meat or melons
- Warm armor if it's snowy
- A bed and a roof

And remember: rain is free water.
